SELECT id, region_id AS regionId, category_id AS categoryId, product_name AS name, price, description, image_url AS imageUrl,
CASE region_id WHEN 1 THEN '札幌' WHEN 2 THEN '小樽' WHEN 3 THEN '函館' WHEN 4 THEN '北見' WHEN 5 THEN '帯広' WHEN 6 THEN '稚内' ELSE '不明' END AS regionName
FROM products

SELECT id, region_id AS regionId, category_id AS categoryId, product_name AS name, price, description, image_url AS imageUrl,
CASE region_id WHEN 1 THEN '札幌' WHEN 2 THEN '小樽' WHEN 3 THEN '函館' WHEN 4 THEN '北見' WHEN 5 THEN '帯広' WHEN 6 THEN '稚内' ELSE '不明' END AS regionName
FROM products
WHERE region_id = #{regionId}

SELECT id, region_id AS regionId, category_id AS categoryId, product_name AS name, price, description, image_url AS imageUrl,
CASE region_id WHEN 1 THEN '札幌' WHEN 2 THEN '小樽' WHEN 3 THEN '函館' WHEN 4 THEN '北見' WHEN 5 THEN '帯広' WHEN 6 THEN '稚内' ELSE '不明' END AS regionName
FROM products
WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}

SELECT p.id, p.product_name AS productName, p.price, p.image_url AS imageUrl, p.region_id AS regionId,
CASE p.region_id WHEN 1 THEN '札幌' WHEN 2 THEN '小樽' WHEN 3 THEN '函館' WHEN 4 THEN '北見' WHEN 5 THEN '帯広' WHEN 6 THEN '稚内' ELSE '不明' END AS regionName,
SUM(od.quantity) AS totalQuantity
FROM products p
INNER JOIN order_details od ON p.id = od.product_id
WHERE p.category_id = #{categoryId}
GROUP BY p.id, p.product_name, p.price, p.image_url, p.region_id
ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC
LIMIT 3
